name: Handout 3: Omens Observed
player_description:
AUSPICIA ADVERSA — COHORTIS XIV LEGIO

The following signs observed in the seven days preceding this report:
- All camp dogs died at midnight on the third day. No visible cause.
- Sacrificial sheep presented black livers at both morning observations.
- Ravens observed flying reversed pattern over the principia on two occasions.
- Springs in the northeast sector run red (iron contamination suspected).
- Night sentries report shadows without bodies along the east palisade.
- Legionaries report distant war-horns; no enemy force located.

The augury is not favorable. I advise against major operations until expiation is performed.

Haruspex Gaius Paterculus, in the consulship of Rufus and Quintillus
gm_notes:
WHEN: Session 1 pre-session or opening scene. Physical prop establishing the world's current state.
HOW: Index card or folded parchment in precise handwriting. Wax seal or smear for authenticity.
WHAT IT REVEALS: The professional religious officer formally documented that something is wrong. This is official record, not rumor. The Legate has seen this and proceeded anyway — that is the critical implication. Give this early so the party understands the institutional failure is known and deliberate.
